memories.content: Mara flew back to Toronto from Lagos and arrived home on 2026-07-26, feeling reset and saying the trip was more than worth it.
As of 2026-07-26 there was still no word from Nautilus on Daniel's Toronto transfer, though he remained hopeful; the waiting weighed on them.
Mara realized on returning (2026-07-26) that she had missed her friend Priya more than she expected; Priya told her the ICU had been feral without her.

entities.name: Priya
entities.description: Mara's close friend and fellow ICU nurse at the General; distinct from charge nurse Priyanka

memories.content: On 2026-07-26 Mara decided to apply for the permanent ICU position rather than the calmer step-down ward, saying the Lagos trip sorted her head out and she wants the real work with better backup.

entities.name: the General
entities.description: Toronto General Hospital, where Mara works in the ICU

memories.content: Saying goodbye to her mother at the end of the Lagos trip, Mara cried at the door; her mother pressed a wrap of dried fish into her bag (around 2026-07-26).
Mara felt the Lagos trip was worth it because she needed to see her mother with her own eyes and now has that 'banked,' returning feeling reset (2026-07-26).
Back from Lagos, Mara found her cat Jollof acting betrayed by her two-week absence (2026-07-26).
